title: 第689章 逆转乾坤开第688章 王虫战舰
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: “有没有受伤？还能站起来吗？”唐的关切声传入两人的耳朵里。
“有！”精灵反应迅速，将圣骑士翻面展示，“这家伙被烧伤了。”
唐低头看向圣骑士身上的伤，对虫群的攻击大概有了一个数。教会铠甲破开一个大洞，血肉烧伤，这绝非能硬接的攻击。
“先回去治疗，我去拖延虫群。”唐说着，忽然充满气势的大喊一声：“鸣世！”
精灵森林中间爆发一道光芒，十字星开始闪烁。
“收拢！整队！联防！”
精灵背着受伤的圣骑士快步跑回后方大本营，很快看见姆莉，于是速度又快几分。
星之下，强壮的人形蚂蚁与多格正面碰撞，听着唐的声音，多格与人蚁在一击之后快速分开。
多格汇聚魔力挥刀斩地，利用战技击起岩石，组成一道石墙，阻挡部分飞行速度极快的人蚁。
妮蔻隐身穿插在战场中，多次阻击，让落后的同伴先回后方接受治疗，尽量将每个人都救回。
伊芙娜飞空与虫群爆发空战，躲避攻击的同时释放成片的冰锥与火矢，掠过唐的上空时，伊芙娜做了挥空气的动作，又翻包丢下了一瓶黄色药剂。
那是变大药水，在失去稳定的巨人香蕉供应后用一次少一支的药剂。
“唐！接着！”
唐抬头，抓住【空气】，一个空翻的机会多面出招，击退扑向自己的人蚁。
“逆转乾坤吧！金克斯！”
唐迅速摆出几个动作，然后右手四十五度挥天，掌中魔力化作飞镖击碎瓶子。
“铠甲！武装！”
金属吞噬者金克斯爆炸后，液态金属在唐四周形成激流，顺便击飞急速冲来的人蚁，随后收拢，化作帅气的银白色铠甲。
又一波自杀式爆裂飞虫冲撞而来，黄色药剂正好淋下，覆盖了唐的全身。
砰砰砰——爆炸的烟雾将唐覆盖。
山岳大的虫王被掀翻，几只蚂蚁脚不断扑腾，摇摆着难以翻身。
巨大化的铠甲唐落地，激尘翻涌。
唐抓起山岳虫王当做盾牌向王虫战舰发起冲撞，仅此一击，虫群两只巨型单位全部掀翻。
如此突然的巨大化战斗，瞬间转移了虫群的注意。一片战场上，唯二的两只巨型单位被唐按在了地上，人蚁急了。
王虫战舰上飞出大量鳄鱼红头喷火蚂蚁，对着唐喷出超高温火焰。
“本源体！元素附魔！”唐充满气势的喊了两声，全身附着魔力，抬手接住虫群喷出的火焰。
“炎拳！”巨大的火拳砸在山岳虫王的下颌上，恐怖的力量轻松折弯王虫的骨骼。
能够释放腐蚀魔法和毒雾的变异飞行人蚁不断向唐释放攻击，全力阻止唐将两只虫王打死。
唐抓着身后的空气一挡，全透明的披风轻松挡下所有魔法攻击。
“魔法披风！”
这是伊芙娜许久以前就做好的史莱姆披风，一个能够让咒怨爆发全部怨怒的超恐怖装备。
趁着唐吸引火力，姆莉和其他魔法师也快速施法治疗受伤的众人。
“究竟发生了什么事情？”驾驶着护林机甲的大熊前来询问伤员，“你们跑得太快，我们的机甲都快追不上了。”
“跑太快被袭击了。”一位精灵回答，脸色并不好看。
content_en:
"Are you injured? Can you still stand up?" Tang's concerned voice reached the ears of the two of them.
"Yes!" The elf reacted quickly, turning the paladin over and showing it, "This guy was burned."
Tang lowered his head and looked at the injuries on the Paladin's body. He probably counted the number of attacks from the insect swarm. A big hole was opened in the church's armor, and the flesh and blood were burned. This was by no means an attack that could be dealt with forcefully.
"Go back for treatment first, and I'll delay the swarm of insects." Tang said, and suddenly shouted with great momentum: "Mingshi!"
A light burst out in the middle of the Elf Forest, and the cross star began to flash.
"Hold in! Team up! Zone defense!"
The elf carried the injured paladin on his back and ran quickly back to the base camp. He soon saw Mli, so he ran a little faster.
Under the star, the strong humanoid ant collided head-on with Doge. Listening to Tang's voice, Doge and the human ant quickly separated after one blow.
Doge gathered his magic power and slashed the ground with his sword, and used his combat skills to hit rocks to form a stone wall to block some of the extremely fast flying human ants.
Neeko inserted herself into the battlefield invisible and blocked many times, allowing the lagging companions to go back to the rear for treatment and try to save everyone.
Evona flew into the air and engaged in an air battle with the insect swarm. While dodging the attacks, she released shards of ice cones and fire arrows. When they passed over Tang, Evona made a wave of air, then rummaged through her bag and dropped a bottle of yellow potion.
It was the enlargement potion, taken one less at a time after losing a steady supply of giant bananas.
"Don! Go on!"
Tang raised his head, grabbed the [air], and used a somersault to attack from all sides, repelling the human ants that rushed towards him.
"Reverse the situation! Jinx!"
Tang quickly made a few moves, then waved his right hand 45 degrees to the sky, and the magic power in his palm turned into a dart to smash the bottle.
"Armor! Armed!"
After Metal Devourer Jinx exploded, the liquid metal formed a torrent around Tang, knocking away the rapidly charging human ants, and then gathered them, turning into handsome silver-white armor.
Another wave of suicide explosive flying insects rushed over, and the yellow potion rained down, covering Tang's body.
Bang bang bang - the smoke from the explosion covered Don.
"Open!"
The mountain-sized insect king was overturned, and several ants' legs kept flapping, swinging and unable to turn over.
"Cha!"
The huge armor fell to the ground, causing dust to surge.
Tang grabbed the Mountain Insect King and used it as a shield to collide with the King Insect warship. With just one blow, both giant units of the insect swarm were overturned.
Such a sudden huge battle instantly diverted the attention of the insect swarm. On the battlefield, the only two giant units were pinned to the ground by Tang, and Man-Ant became anxious.
A large number of crocodile red-headed fire-breathing ants flew out from the King Insect Battleship, spraying ultra-high-temperature flames at Tang.
"Original body! Elemental enchantment!" Tang shouted twice with great momentum, his whole body covered with magic power, and he raised his hand to catch the flames spurted by the insect swarm.
"Fire Fist!" The huge fire fist hit the mountain insect king's jaw, and the terrifying force easily bent the king insect's bones.
The mutated flying ants that can release corrosive magic and poisonous mist constantly attack Tang, trying their best to prevent Tang from beating the two insect kings to death.
Tang grabbed the air behind him to block it, and his completely transparent cloak easily blocked all magic attacks.
"Magic cloak!"
This is the slime cloak that Evena made a long time ago, a super terrifying equipment that can make the curse explode with all its wrath.
While Tang was attracting firepower, Muli and other magicians quickly cast spells to heal the injured.
"What happened?" Daxiong, who was driving a forest ranger mecha, came to ask the wounded. "You ran too fast, and our mechas could hardly catch up."
"I ran too fast and was attacked." An elf replied, his face not pretty.
